text: In the fall of 2023, the Toronto Zoo launched a strategic planning process to build on, and continue, its mission of connecting people, animals, and conservation science to fight extinction. This report intends to establish a board committee to guide the development of the new 2024-2027 Strategic Plan.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the establishment of a Strategic Planning Committee and appoint three board members to guide the development of the 2024-2027 Strategic Plan.
